class.name: HTMLBaseElement
class.brief_description: A document base URL or default link target.
class.description: Represents [code]<base>[/code]. The first connected base with an [code]href[/code] attribute determines the document's local resource base. Read the effective URL with [method HTMLLayout.get_base_uri].

method.name: get_resolved_href
method.description: Resolves the base element's own address against the original document source.

members.member: The original base address. A trailing slash denotes a directory.
The declared default target for navigation.
